title: anthemis carpatica var. balcanica
intro: Anthemis carpatica var. balcanica, commonly known as Balkan chamois, is a plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, such as fever, headache, and digestive problems, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Anthemis carpatica var. balcanica include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
